source.title: Call for Applicants - WCA Marketing Team Leader (January 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

There will be an appointment of a new WCA Marketing Team Leader, as Saransh Grover’s term is ending. The WCA would like to take this opportunity to thank Saransh for leading the Marketing Team since March of 2021.
<!-- break -->

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the team. The ideal candidate has:

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* A solid background in marketing, with expertise in digital marketing, corporate branding, content creation, sponsorship acquisition and management, and social media strategy.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with a global mindset.
* Strategic thinking and innovation to drive the WCA’s marketing efforts forward.
* A passion for cubing and a commitment to the WCA’s mission.

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until February 20th, 2025, 23:59 UTC.** Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team ([assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)), CC’ing the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
3. Ambitions as the Marketing Team Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the Marketing Team can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2024.7](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.7%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 市场推广团队负责人招募（2025 年 1 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

Saransh Grover 任期即将结束，WCA 将任命新的市场推广团队负责人。借此机会，WCA 感谢 Saransh 自 2021 年 3 月以来对市场推广团队的领导。

候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 8 小时处理团队工作。理想的候选人应具备：

* 出色的领导和团队管理能力。
* 扎实的市场营销背景，熟悉数字营销、机构品牌建设、内容创作、赞助洽谈与管理，以及社交媒体策略。
* 出色的沟通协作能力及全球视野。
* 能从长远规划并提出新想法，推动 WCA 的市场推广工作。
* 热爱魔方，并认同 WCA 的使命。

申请时间为**即日起至 2025 年 2 月 20 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至执行助理团队（[assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)），并抄送 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WCA 市场推广团队负责人后的工作设想。

申请者还须提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

市场推广团队的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2024.7](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.7%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 动议 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，通过投票选定并公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
